final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes (3 of 3).

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now strips accent marks before calling the vendored `slugify`, which I left alone as you asked.

Shop product URLs call `vendor/slugify` directly, so they still drop accented letters. Fixing that would mean a similar wrapper in `src/shop/product-url.js` or an upgrade of the vendored package by the platform team. I didn't touch either.
